thread:
Sasha: thinking about adding an "amortized cold-start" line to the per-model econ card — shows 7d GPU warmup cost spread across invocations + cache-savings allocated back to routes. would help teams see hidden warmup costs :thinking:
Tom: love the idea. question: do we attribute warmup to model sku or to calling route? both have tradeoffs for chargebacks.
Leah: prefer attributing to the route that triggered the warmup (first-owner), otherwise infra gets all the noise. we already do first-owner for prefetch credits.
Mike: +1 for first-owner but we need clear provenance so we can recompute if routing changes. that means emitting a cold_start_event id in telemetry.
Sasha: telemetry plan: add `cold_start_id` to invocation events and an `amortization_window_s` field in model_warmup events. then console can join by id and compute per-route amortization.
Tom: how expensive will joins be for the dashboard? we render many cards on one page.
Leah: we should pre-aggregate into a materialized table. suggestion SQL for nightly rollup:
```sql
INSERT INTO econ_rollup_daily (model_id, route_id, warmup_cost, warmup_invocations, cache_savings_alloc)
SELECT m.id, r.id, SUM(w.cost), COUNT(i.id), SUM(s.savings)
FROM model_warmup w
JOIN invocation i USING (cold_start_id)
JOIN route r ON i.route_id = r.id
LEFT JOIN cache_savings s ON i.invocation_id = s.invocation_id
WHERE w.ts >= current_date - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY m.id, r.id;
```
Mike: that looks fine. we should also expose a lightweight read API for the console so the UI doesn't hit raw rollups directly. e.g., `GET /console/econ/models/{model_id}/routes?window=7d`
Sasha: UI mock: small sparkline for amortized warmup next to token cost, and a toggle to display 'cache-adjusted' vs 'raw'. default to cache-adjusted.
Tom: UX concern: teams might misinterpret amortized numbers as recurring overhead. add tooltip: "This number spreads one-time warmup cost across invocations in the selected window."
Leah: rollout plan: feature-flag in console, sample mode where we show estimates for 5% of models to validate. run A/B: variant A shows model-sku attribution, variant B shows route attribution.
Mike: ops-bot: can you add an alert if warmup_cost / total_cost > 0.2 for any route? would be a good signal for model pinning or prewarming.
infra-bot: alert rule created: `econ.warmup_ratio > 0.2` scoped per-route, cooldown 6h.
Sasha: open question: how to credit cache savings when multiple routes share cached prefixes? current idea: split savings pro rata by CPU time or token delta per route invocation that benefited.
Leah: agree pro rata by token_delta makes sense. may need to include `kv_cache_hit_tokens` in telemetry.
Tom: is there any API break? adding fields to invocation events should be backwards-compatible. just bump the telemetry schema minor version.
Mike: action items:
- sasha: write console mock + tooltip copy (due in 2d)
- leah: spec telemetry additions + sample SQL (due EOD)
- tom: perf estimate on rollup query and memory needs (due 3d)
- mike: expose read API + alert (due 4d)
Sasha: ok i'll create the feature-flagged PR and a lightweight canary (5% models) once infra changes land. thanks all :thumbsup:
